## Trend

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

# ============================================================
# 0) helpers
# ============================================================
parse_pop_safe <- function(x) {
  x <- na_if(as.character(x), "Not Applicable")
  readr::parse_number(x, na = c("", "NA", "Not Applicable"))
}

recode_to_std_age <- function(age_code) {
  age_code <- as.character(age_code)
  dplyr::case_when(
    age_code %in% c("85-89", "90-94", "95-99", "100+") ~ "85+",
    TRUE ~ age_code
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 1) 2000 US standard weights (ALL ages; your "split bins" version)
# ============================================================
std2000_allages <- tibble(
  age_code = c(
    "1","1-4",
    "5-9","10-14",
    "15-19","20-24",
    "25-29","30-34",
    "35-39","40-44",
    "45-49","50-54",
    "55-59","60-64",
    "65-69","70-74",
    "75-79","80-84",
    "85+"
  ),
  std_million = c(
    13818, 55317,
    145565/2, 145565/2,
    138646/2, 138646/2,
    135573/2, 135573/2,
    162613/2, 162613/2,
    134834/2, 134834/2,
    87247/2,  87247/2,
    66037/2,  66037/2,
    44842/2,  44842/2,
    15508
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    std_million = round(std_million),
    weight = std_million / sum(std_million)
  )

# ---- map 5-year age_code -> 4 bands (age4)
age_band_map <- tibble(
  age_code = std2000_allages$age_code,
  age4 = c(
    rep("<20",     5),
    rep("20_44",   5),
    rep("45_64",   4),
    rep("65_plus", 5)
  )
)

# ============================================================
# 2) identify partition vars causing duplicated population
#    (match make_year_table_with_aamr logic)
# ============================================================
get_part_vars <- function(dat) {
  pv <- intersect(c("Sex", "Single Race 6", "Race"), names(dat))
  if (all(c("Race", "Single Race 6") %in% pv)) pv <- setdiff(pv, "Race")
  pv
}

# ============================================================
# 3) canonical prep
# ============================================================
prep_base <- function(df, year_min = 2010, year_max = 2025) {
  df %>%
    filter(is.na(Notes) | Notes != "Total") %>%
    mutate(
      YearCode   = suppressWarnings(as.integer(`Year Code`)),
      YearKey    = as.character(YearCode),
      Deaths     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Deaths)),
      Population = parse_pop_safe(Population),
      age_code   = recode_to_std_age(`Five-Year Age Groups Code`)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(YearCode), YearCode >= year_min, YearCode <= year_max) %>%
    filter(age_code %in% std2000_allages$age_code)
}

# ============================================================
# 4) canonical "YA" table: YearCode × age_code with DEDUPED POP
#    This is the one table BOTH pipelines must use.
# ============================================================
build_ya_dedup <- function(base_dat) {
  pv <- get_part_vars(base_dat)

  base_dat %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(c("YearCode", "age_code", pv)))) %>%
    summarise(
      deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      pop    = suppressWarnings(max(Population, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(pop = ifelse(is.infinite(pop), NA_real_, pop)) %>%
    group_by(YearCode, age_code) %>%
    summarise(
      deaths = sum(deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      pop    = sum(pop,    na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# ============================================================
# 5) AAMR (ALL AGES) from YA
# ============================================================
calc_aamr_allages_by_year <- function(ya) {
  ya %>%
    left_join(std2000_allages, by = "age_code") %>%
    mutate(age_rate = ifelse(pop > 0, (deaths / pop) * 1e5, NA_real_)) %>%
    group_by(YearCode) %>%
    summarise(AAMR_allages = sum(age_rate * weight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(YearKey = as.character(YearCode)) %>%
    select(YearKey, AAMR_allages)
}

calc_aamr_allages_total <- function(ya) {
  ya %>%
    group_by(age_code) %>%
    summarise(
      deaths = sum(deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      pop    = sum(pop,    na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(std2000_allages, by = "age_code") %>%
    mutate(age_rate = ifelse(pop > 0, (deaths / pop) * 1e5, NA_real_)) %>%
    summarise(
      YearKey = "Total",
      AAMR_allages = sum(age_rate * weight, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}

# ============================================================
# 6) AAMR (BY AGE BAND) from YA
#    - weights are renormalized within each band
# ============================================================
calc_aamr_band_by_year <- function(ya) {
  ya %>%
    left_join(age_band_map, by = "age_code") %>%
    left_join(std2000_allages %>% select(age_code, weight), by = "age_code") %>%
    group_by(YearCode, age4) %>%
    mutate(
      w_band   = weight / sum(weight),
      age_rate = ifelse(pop > 0, (deaths / pop) * 1e5, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    summarise(AAMR_band = sum(age_rate * w_band, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(YearKey = as.character(YearCode)) %>%
    select(YearKey, age4, AAMR_band)
}

calc_aamr_band_total <- function(ya) {
  ya %>%
    group_by(age_code) %>%
    summarise(
      deaths = sum(deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      pop    = sum(pop,    na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(age_band_map, by = "age_code") %>%
    left_join(std2000_allages %>% select(age_code, weight), by = "age_code") %>%
    group_by(age4) %>%
    mutate(
      w_band   = weight / sum(weight),
      age_rate = ifelse(pop > 0, (deaths / pop) * 1e5, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      YearKey = "Total",
      AAMR_band = sum(age_rate * w_band, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# ============================================================
# 7) aligned wrapper: returns BOTH overall-AAMR and band-AAMR tables
# ============================================================
aamr_allages_and_bands <- function(df, year_min = 2010, year_max = 2025) {

  base <- prep_base(df, year_min, year_max)
  ya   <- build_ya_dedup(base)

  # overall AAMR (year + total)
  allages_year  <- calc_aamr_allages_by_year(ya) %>%
    complete(YearKey = as.character(year_min:year_max), fill = list(AAMR_allages = NA_real_))
  allages_total <- calc_aamr_allages_total(ya)
  allages_tbl   <- bind_rows(allages_year, allages_total) %>%
    mutate(YearKey = factor(YearKey, levels = c(as.character(year_min:year_max), "Total"))) %>%
    arrange(YearKey)

  # band AAMR (year + total)
  band_year  <- calc_aamr_band_by_year(ya) %>%
    complete(
      YearKey = as.character(year_min:year_max),
      age4    = c("<20","20_44","45_64","65_plus"),
      fill    = list(AAMR_band = NA_real_)
    )
  band_total <- calc_aamr_band_total(ya)
  band_tbl   <- bind_rows(band_year, band_total) %>%
    mutate(
      YearKey = factor(YearKey, levels = c(as.character(year_min:year_max), "Total")),
      age4    = factor(age4, levels = c("<20","20_44","45_64","65_plus"))
    ) %>%
    arrange(YearKey, age4)

  list(
    ya = ya,                 # the canonical deduped denominators
    allages = allages_tbl,   # YearKey + Total overall AAMR
    bands   = band_tbl       # YearKey + Total band AAMR
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 8) Use it to build the SAME outputs you had before
#    (example for your 3 datasets)
# ============================================================
out_aki   <- aamr_allages_and_bands(N17,    2010, 2025)
out_sep   <- aamr_allages_and_bands(A40,    2010, 2025)
out_both  <- aamr_allages_and_bands(N17A40_RF, 2010, 2025)

# ---- overall AAMR by year (wide), aligned across datasets ----
overall_aamr_tbl <- out_aki$allages %>%
  rename(AKI = AAMR_allages) %>%
  left_join(out_sep$allages %>% rename(Sepsis = AAMR_allages), by = "YearKey") %>%
  left_join(out_both$allages %>% rename(`AKI/sepsis` = AAMR_allages), by = "YearKey") %>%
  mutate(
    `Sepsis among AKI ((3)/(1))` = ifelse(AKI > 0, `AKI/sepsis` / AKI, NA_real_),
    `AKI among Sepsis ((3)/(2))` = ifelse(Sepsis > 0, `AKI/sepsis` / Sepsis, NA_real_)
  )

overall_aamr_tbl

# ---- band AAMR trend in your original "aamr_trend long" style ----
aamr_trend <- bind_rows(
  out_aki$bands  %>% mutate(dataset = "AKI"),
  out_sep$bands  %>% mutate(dataset = "Sepsis"),
  out_both$bands %>% mutate(dataset = "AKI/sepsis")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(as.character(YearKey)),
    age_group = recode(as.character(age4),
      "<20" = "<20",
      "20_44" = "20–44",
      "45_64" = "45–64",
      "65_plus" = "65+"
    ),
    age_group = factor(age_group, levels = c("<20","20–44","45–64","65+"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Year)) %>%   # drops Total for plotting; keep if you want it
  transmute(
    Year,
    dataset,
    age_group,
    AAMR = AAMR_band
  )

aamr_trend
```

### Sex

```{r}
calc_sex_aamr_trend <- function(df, dataset_name,
                                year_min = 2010, year_max = 2025) {

  # --- prep like your other pipeline ---
  base <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(Notes) | Notes != "Total") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Year     = suppressWarnings(as.integer(`Year Code`)),
      YearKey  = as.character(Year),
      Deaths   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Deaths)),
      Population = parse_pop_safe(Population),
      age_code = recode_to_std_age(`Five-Year Age Groups Code`)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Year), Year >= year_min, Year <= year_max) %>%
    dplyr::filter(age_code %in% std2000_allages$age_code) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Sex))

  # --- partition vars: align with your collapse_for_rates logic ---
  rp <- NULL
  if ("Single Race 6" %in% names(base)) rp <- "Single Race 6"
  if ("Race" %in% names(base) && is.null(rp)) rp <- "Race"

  pv <- c("Sex", rp)
  pv <- pv[!is.null(pv)]
  pv <- pv[pv %in% names(base)]

  # --- dedupe Population within strata, then sum to true denominator ---
  ya_sex <- base %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c("YearKey", "Year", "age_code", pv)))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      pop    = suppressWarnings(max(Population, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pop = dplyr::if_else(is.infinite(pop), NA_real_, pop)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Year, YearKey, Sex, age_code) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      deaths = sum(deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      pop    = sum(pop,    na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # --- AAMR standardization ---
  ya_sex %>%
    dplyr::left_join(std2000_allages %>% dplyr::select(age_code, weight), by = "age_code") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(age_rate = dplyr::if_else(pop > 0, (deaths / pop) * 1e5, NA_real_)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Year, Sex) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      AAMR = sum(age_rate * weight, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      dataset = trimws(dataset_name),
      Sex = factor(trimws(Sex), levels = c("Male", "Female"))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dataset, Sex, Year)
}

  calc_sex_aamr_trend(A40,       "Sepsis"),
  calc_sex_aamr_trend(N17A40_RF, "AKI/sepsis")
)
```

### Overlap

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

period_map <- tibble(
  period = c("Pre-pandemic (2010–2019)",
             "Pandemic (2020–2022)",
             "Transition (2023)",
             "Post-pandemic (2024–2025)"),
  year_start = c(2010, 2020, 2023, 2024),
  year_end   = c(2019, 2022, 2023, 2025)
)

add_period <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    left_join(period_map, join_by(Year >= year_start, Year <= year_end)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(period)) %>%
    mutate(period = factor(period, levels = period_map$period))
}

parse_pop_safe <- function(x) {
  x <- na_if(x, "Not Applicable")
  readr::parse_number(x, na = c("", "NA", "Not Applicable"))
}

```

```{r}
deaths_by_period <- function(df, label, year_min = 2010, year_max = 2025) {
  df %>%
    filter(is.na(Notes) | Notes != "Total") %>%
    mutate(
      Year = as.integer(`Year Code`),
      Deaths = as.numeric(Deaths)
    ) %>%
    filter(Year >= year_min, Year <= year_max) %>%
    group_by(Year) %>%
    summarise(deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    add_period() %>%
    group_by(period) %>%
    summarise(deaths = sum(deaths, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(dataset = label)
}

# ----------------------------
# Build overlap decomposition per period
# ----------------------------
arf_p  <- deaths_by_period(N17,    "AKI")
sep_p  <- deaths_by_period(A40,    "Sepsis")
both_p <- deaths_by_period(N17A40_RF, "AKI/sepsis")   # overlap

overlap_period_pct <- arf_p %>%
  select(period, arf = deaths) %>%
  left_join(sep_p  %>% select(period, sepsis = deaths), by = "period") %>%
  left_join(both_p %>% select(period, both = deaths),   by = "period") %>%
  mutate(
    arf_only    = pmax(arf - both, 0),
    sepsis_only = pmax(sepsis - both, 0),
    total_union = arf_only + sepsis_only + both
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(arf_only, sepsis_only, both),
    names_to = "category_raw",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = recode(category_raw,
                      arf_only = "AKI",
                      sepsis_only = "Sepsis",
                      both = "AKI/sepsis"),
    category = factor(category, levels = c("AKI", "AKI/sepsis", "Sepsis")),
    pct = ifelse(total_union > 0, value / total_union, NA_real_),
    pct_label = ifelse(!is.na(pct), paste0(sprintf("%.1f", 100 * pct), "%"), NA_character_)
  )
```

```{r}
  )
```

```{r}
calc_aamr_lt20_trend <- function(df, dataset_name, year_min = 2010, year_max = 2025) {

  lt20_codes <- c("1","1-4","5-9","10-14","15-19")

  base <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(Notes) | Notes != "Total") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Year       = suppressWarnings(as.integer(`Year Code`)),
      YearKey    = as.character(Year),
      Deaths     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Deaths)),
      Population = parse_pop_safe(Population),
      age_code   = trimws(as.character(`Five-Year Age Groups Code`))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Year), Year >= year_min, Year <= year_max) %>%
    dplyr::filter(age_code %in% lt20_codes)

  # partition vars (align with your other dedupe logic)
  rp <- NULL
  if ("Single Race 6" %in% names(base)) rp <- "Single Race 6"
  if ("Race" %in% names(base) && is.null(rp)) rp <- "Race"

  pv <- c("Sex", rp)
  pv <- pv[!is.null(pv)]
  pv <- pv[pv %in% names(base)]

  # 1) dedupe pop within stratum (Year × age × pv) via max
  # 2) sum strata -> true Year × age denominator
  year_age <- base %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c("YearKey","Year","age_code", pv)))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      pop    = dplyr::if_else(all(is.na(Population)), NA_real_,
                              suppressWarnings(max(Population, na.rm = TRUE))),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pop = dplyr::if_else(is.infinite(pop), NA_real_, pop)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Year, YearKey, age_code) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      deaths = sum(deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      pop    = sum(pop,    na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  year_age %>%
    dplyr::left_join(std2000_allages %>% dplyr::select(age_code, weight), by = "age_code") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Year) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      w_band   = weight / sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE),   # renormalize within <20
      age_rate = dplyr::if_else(pop > 0, (deaths / pop) * 1e5, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      AAMR_lt20 = sum(age_rate * w_band, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dataset = trimws(dataset_name)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dataset, Year)
}

)
```

```{r}
# Helper: sum <20 deaths + population for selected years
sum_lt20_deaths_pop <- function(df, label) {
  df %>%
    filter(is.na(Notes) | Notes != "Total") %>%
    mutate(
      Year       = as.integer(`Year Code`),
      Deaths     = as.numeric(Deaths),
      Population = parse_pop_safe(Population),
      age_code  = `Five-Year Age Groups Code`
    ) %>%
    filter(
      Year %in% yrs_check,
      age_code %in% lt20_codes
    ) %>%
    group_by(Year) %>%
    summarise(
      Deaths_lt20 = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      Pop_lt20    = sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(dataset = label)
}

# ---- AKI vs AKI & Sepsis ----
lt20_deaths_pop <- bind_rows(
  sum_lt20_deaths_pop(N17,   "AKI"),
  sum_lt20_deaths_pop(N17A40,"AKI & Sepsis")
) %>%
  arrange(Year, dataset)

lt20_deaths_pop
```

### All

```{r}
calc_aamr_trend_all_ages <- function(df, dataset_name, year_min = 2010, year_max = 2025) {

  base <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(Notes) | Notes != "Total") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Year     = suppressWarnings(as.integer(`Year Code`)),
      YearKey  = as.character(Year),
      Deaths   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Deaths)),
      Population = parse_pop_safe(Population),
      age_code = recode_to_std_age(`Five-Year Age Groups Code`)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Year), Year >= year_min, Year <= year_max) %>%
    dplyr::filter(age_code %in% std2000_allages$age_code)

  # Partition vars (align with your other logic)
  rp <- NULL
  if ("Single Race 6" %in% names(base)) rp <- "Single Race 6"
  if ("Race" %in% names(base) && is.null(rp)) rp <- "Race"

  pv <- c("Sex", rp)                     # include Sex if present; harmless for "all ages"
  pv <- pv[!is.null(pv)]
  pv <- pv[pv %in% names(base)]

  # 1) dedupe pop within stratum (Year × age × pv)
  # 2) sum strata -> true Year × age denominator
  year_age <- base %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c("YearKey", "Year", "age_code", pv)))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      pop    = suppressWarnings(max(Population, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pop = dplyr::if_else(is.infinite(pop), NA_real_, pop)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Year, YearKey, age_code) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      deaths = sum(deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      pop    = sum(pop,    na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  year_age %>%
    dplyr::left_join(std2000_allages %>% dplyr::select(age_code, weight), by = "age_code") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(age_rate = dplyr::if_else(pop > 0, (deaths / pop) * 1e5, NA_real_)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Year) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      AAMR = sum(age_rate * weight, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dataset = trimws(dataset_name)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dataset, Year)
}


```

```{r}
aamr_trend_all_ages <- bind_rows(
  calc_aamr_trend_all_ages(N17,    "AKI"),
  calc_aamr_trend_all_ages(A40,    "Sepsis"),
  calc_aamr_trend_all_ages(N17A40_RF, "AKI/sepsis")
)
```

```{r}
p_aamr_all_ages <- ggplot(aamr_trend_all_ages, aes(x = Year, y = AAMR, color = dataset)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 2019.5, xmax = 2022.5,
    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
    fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.18
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 2022.5, xmax = 2023.5,
    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
    fill = "grey40", alpha = 0.14
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.3) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "AKI" = "#0072B2",
      "Sepsis"              = "#D55E00",
      "AKI/sepsis"        = "#009E73"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2010, 2025, 3)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "AAMR (per 100,000)",
    color = "Disease",
    caption = "Grey shading: 2020–2022 (pandemic); darker shading: 2023 (transition)."
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

### Baseline

```{r}
overlap_table_aamr
```

```{r}
aamr_long <- overlap_table_aamr %>%
  filter(Year != "Total") %>%
  mutate(Year = as.integer(as.character(Year))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      `ARF (AAMR 25–85+)`,
      `Sepsis (AAMR 25–85+)`,
      `ARF & Sepsis (AAMR 25–85+)`
    ),
    names_to = "Outcome",
    values_to = "AAMR"
  )
```

```{r}
growth_summary <- aamr_long %>%
  group_by(Outcome) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_2010_2019 = mean(AAMR[Year >= 2010 & Year <= 2019], na.rm = TRUE),
    peak_aamr          = max(AAMR, na.rm = TRUE),
    peak_year          = Year[which.max(AAMR)],
    aamr_2025          = AAMR[Year == 2025],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    growth_peak_vs_baseline =
      (peak_aamr - baseline_2010_2019) / baseline_2010_2019,
    growth_2025_vs_baseline =
      (aamr_2025 - baseline_2010_2019) / baseline_2010_2019
  )

```

```{r}
growth_table_pub <- growth_summary %>%
  transmute(
    Outcome,
    `Baseline AAMR (2010–2019)` = round(baseline_2010_2019, 2),
    `Peak AAMR` = round(peak_aamr, 2),
    `Peak year` = peak_year,
    `AAMR in 2025` = round(aamr_2025, 2),
    `Growth: Peak vs Baseline (%)` =
      round(growth_peak_vs_baseline * 100, 1),
    `Growth: 2025 vs Baseline (%)` =
      round(growth_2025_vs_baseline * 100, 1)
  )

growth_table_pub

```

```{r}
growth_ft <- flextable(growth_table_pub) |>
  autofit() |>
  set_caption(
    "Relative change in mortality rates at pandemic peak and in 2025 compared with the 2010–2019 average"
  ) |>
  align(align = "center", part = "all") |>
  bold(part = "header") |>
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") |>
  theme_booktabs()
```
